help_texts.confirm: Confirming registers the money as received: the payment is marked successful and its order becomes paid and moves to processing. The customer is notified.
help_texts.fail: Failing marks this payment as failed. The order stays unpaid and the customer can pay it again.

success.title: Confirm payment
success.desc: Mark payment #{{id}} as successful? Its order will be marked paid and move to processing.

failed.title: Mark payment as failed
failed.desc: Mark payment #{{id}} as failed? The order stays unpaid and the customer can pay it again.
